biology: Specimens collected from Chinese sweetgum (Liquidambar formosana).
distribution: Mount Huashui, Yingde, Guangdong, and Hunan.
soldier: Head of the soldier orange-yellow, the frons darker and the posterior half paler, the antennal ridges yellowish brown, a large dark brown spot on each side of the clypeus; mandibles brownish, their bases yellowish brown; labrum, antennae and pronotum pale yellow; abdomen and legs paler. Pilosity of the head extremely sparse; the labral apex bears one pair each of apical and lateral apical setae. Head broad, lateral margins parallel, widest at about the posterior third, contracting evenly and roundly posteriorly; frontal peaks slightly raised, not higher than the dorsal surface of the occiput, slightly concave behind the peaks towards the fontanelle, the fontanelle small and circular. Labrum ligulate, widest at the base, the transparent part of the labral tip bluntly rounded. Mandibles sabre-shaped, the apex slightly incurved, the inner margin toothless; the base of the left mandible with three saw-like structures, the third the largest, with another large tooth-like swelling at the base. Postmentum narrow and long, broad anteriorly, narrowest in the middle, the widest part more than twice the narrowest. Antennae 16–17 segments, the first segment stout and long, the third or fourth the shortest and smallest. Anterior margin of the pronotum with a broad and deep central concavity, the anterior lateral corners rounded and projecting outwards, posterior margin only slightly concave in the middle.
taxonomy_note: The species was placed in Tsaitermes in the original work; it is here placed in Reticulitermes.
